common_direction: Speak clear, natural conversational American English. Use a comfortable medium pace and natural sentence pauses so a high-school English learner can follow. Keep an everyday human delivery, with no music or sound effects, no announcer performance, and no theatrical exaggeration. Read only the supplied text.

voices.name: 小帅
voices.personality: 真诚、内敛、容易紧张，逐渐愿意自己开口
voices.direction_zh: 轻柔清亮的少年男声，略带气息；自然思考停顿，紧张但不持续结巴。与分身保持相近的基础声线。
voices.instruct: The speaker is a 16-year-old male high-school student. A light, youthful tenor, with a little breathiness and a slightly reedy, unpolished teenage texture. Modest chest resonance. He is sincere, thoughtful and a little shy. He speaks gently, with small thinking pauses and understated emotion, gradually finding the confidence to finish his thought. Keep a believable adolescent male sound, without a deep adult presenter voice or a squeaky child voice.
voices.text: Give me a second. I want to say this myself. I get nervous when everyone is looking at me, but that doesn't mean I have nothing to say. Let's start with one question, and listen to the answer before we move on.

voices.name: 苏小满
voices.personality: 清醒、细心、直率，有自己的广播目标，也会不自信
voices.direction_zh: 轻柔、舒缓、有耐心的16岁少女声；柔软起音、轻盈共鸣、少量自然气息，音量克制，语速稍缓，句尾轻收。情绪平和、像在近处安慰熟悉的朋友；减少强调、尖亮感与上扬，保留自然清晰的英语发音。用户已确认先使用当前音色，作为后续配音参考。
voices.instruct: A gentle, soft-spoken 16-year-old girl speaking tenderly to a close friend beside her. A light, delicate teenage female voice, softly rounded and slightly airy, with a smooth warm tone and gentle vowel onsets. Her manner is caring, patient, modest and reassuring. Speak quietly at a comfortable unhurried conversational pace. Use small natural pauses, restrained pitch movement, soft sentence endings and very little emphatic stress. Let the words feel like a calm personal conversation with someone she trusts. Keep the voice youthful and clearly audible, with normal speech rather than whispering. Avoid sharp bright projection, punchy consonants, excited upward inflections, a forceful confident performance, a presenter delivery, heavy adult resonance, or babyish sweetness.
voices.text: Hey, take your time. I'm listening. You don't have to get every word right. I get nervous too, especially when something really matters to me. We can try it together. And this time, I'd like to finish telling you my idea.

voices.name: 陈野
voices.personality: 爽朗、踏实、有团队意识，习惯自己扛任务
voices.direction_zh: 比小帅稍结实、偏中音的少年男声，爽朗放松，鼓励别人时自然平等；仍有高中生年龄感。
voices.instruct: A 17-year-old male high-school basketball teammate. A youthful medium-register male voice, slightly fuller and more grounded than a light tenor, with a small amount of natural teenage roughness. Friendly, straightforward, relaxed and dependable. He encourages a teammate as an equal, with an easy smile and unforced confidence. Keep light adolescent resonance and conversational phrasing. No deep adult coach voice, shouting or sports-announcer performance.
voices.text: You don't have to be the best player on your first day. Watch where your teammates are, and give yourself time to learn. If you need a break, say so. We're on the same team, and asking for help is part of playing together.

voices.name: 小帅妈妈
voices.personality: 温暖、务实、耐心，有平静的幽默感
voices.direction_zh: 约40岁妈妈的成熟中低女声，胸腔共鸣更扎实，声音厚实，带轻微干涩与生活质感；少气声、少上扬，语尾落稳。温暖来自从容与耐心，保留务实和轻微冷幽默。已获用户试听确认，作为后续配音的参考音色。
voices.instruct: A middle-aged woman of forty to forty-five, the mother of a teenage son, speaking to him at home. Her voice has a clearly mature, lived-in adult female quality: a rich low-middle alto register, substantial warm chest resonance, a slightly husky dry grain, and firm, fully voiced vowels. Use restrained pitch movement and settled downward sentence endings. Her delivery is grounded, matter-of-fact and unhurried, with the quiet confidence and gentle dry humor of an experienced parent. Warmth comes from patience and calm assurance. Keep the voice distinctly feminine, naturally healthy and conversational, with clean articulation. Avoid a youthful bright placement, high airy sweetness, breathy girlish softness, sing-song upward inflections, an elderly quaver, or an exaggerated gravelly performance.
voices.text: I'm happy to tell you about my day. Just ask me when I'm ready, all right? Coming home doesn't always mean I'm free. Sometimes the kindest thing you can do is leave a little space in the plan. We can talk after breakfast tomorrow.

voices.name: 小帅爸爸
voices.personality: 沉稳、务实、支持孩子，表达简洁
voices.direction_zh: 温和稳重的成年男性中低音，自然放松，像在家商量日常安排；性格与具体年龄为首轮制作建议。
voices.instruct: A father in his early forties talking casually with his teenage son at home. A warm adult male low-middle register, naturally grounded and lightly textured, with relaxed ordinary speech. Calm, practical and supportive, speaking in short clear thoughts with a little quiet humor. He sounds approachable and human. No booming authority, threatening sternness, elderly rasp or polished radio-host delivery.
voices.text: Let's make room for everyone. You can share the house, and you can share the chores too. Tell us what you've agreed to do, and what help you need. We'll work it out together. For now, start with the dishes on the table.
voices.casting_note: 父亲身份已确定；43岁及沉稳支持型声线为制作建议，不新增故事经历。

voices.instruct: A male homeroom teacher in his early forties speaking to high-school students in a quiet classroom. voices.text: Before you agree to another activity, check the time. You can ask for help, but you still need to make your own choices. Tell me what you can finish, and we'll make a realistic schedule. Taking responsibility starts with being clear about your commitments.

voices.instruct: A 16-year-old male high-school classmate with a youthful medium-register voice, a little natural nasal resonance and a lightly grainy teenage texture. Easygoing, candid and friendly. voices.personality: 温和、真诚，初见有些害羞，熟悉后愿意分享
voices.direction_zh: 柔和轻盈的少女声，略带气息，思考后再说，分享经历时逐渐放松；与苏小满的清爽利落区分。
voices.instruct: A 16-year-old female high-school student sharing an honest first-day memory with classmates. A soft, light mid-high teenage voice, gently airy with delicate resonance. Kind, sincere and slightly shy at first, then more relaxed as she tells her story. Natural small thinking pauses and quiet warmth, without whispering. Distinct from a brisk, direct teenage organizer. voices.text: On my first day, I was too shy to ask for help. Then I met another student who was lost too. We asked someone together, and she showed us the way. I didn't suddenly become brave. I just felt less alone, and that made it easier.
